# Banksman

> Banksman is construction site management software for small and mid-size UK building firms. It was built by Dom Keady, a bricklayer who runs his own building firm in Huddersfield, and is a product of DM.AI 4U Ltd.

Banksman keeps a building firm's tasks, timesheets, material requests, drawings, site photos, messages and health and safety records in one app for managers and workers. It runs in the browser and installs on a phone's home screen like any other app, with no app store needed.

## Features

- Tasks with photo proof: the manager sets tasks per site; workers tick them off and add a photo.
- Timesheets: daywork or price work per site or plot, approved or queried by the manager, CSV export.
- Material requests: requested, approved, ordered, dispatched and delivered, with supplier, order reference and a delivery photo.
- Drawings for every site, on every phone, labelled by version.
- Photo library: every photo stamped with upload time, site, task and who took it.
- Site group chats and direct messages, kept apart from personal phone chats.
- Health and safety documents (inductions, RAMS, COSHH) signed on the phone, with revisions and a record of who signed what.
- Site sign-in and sign-out with a QR poster, an optional location check at sign-in only, and a fire roll call.
- Accident and near-miss reports, with RIDDOR flags, actions and a monthly safety summary.
- Manager dashboard, push notifications, your logo and colours, bigger text option.

## Pricing (all prices include VAT, no contract, cancel any time)

- Starter: £79 a month, up to 10 users.
- Growth: £149 a month, up to 25 users.
- Enterprise: £299 a month, up to 75 users.
- White label add-on: £999 one-off on top of any plan. Includes three 1-on-1 calls with Dom and Matt, exclusive features built for the customer, and a fully customised app.
- Every plan includes every feature and an optional onboarding call.

## Who it's for

Builders, bricklayers, groundworkers, roofers, electricians, plumbers, subcontractors, worktop fabricators and fitters, interior fit-out teams, scaffolders, joiners, steel erectors and window fitters in the UK.

## Common questions

- Does Banksman need an app store download? No. It installs to the phone home screen and opens like an app, with push notifications.
- Does it work offline? Not yet. Offline mode is being built.
- Does it produce electrical, gas or CIS certificates or invoices? No. It runs the job on site; CIS worker invoices are being built.
- Can data be exported? Yes. Every table exports to CSV.
- Is there a free trial? There is a live demo of the real app on realistic sample data, with no card and no sales call.
